messages:

Cc: AP Team <ap@copperrock.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding - bank details & invoice routing questions

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the vendor setup for CopperRock Capital and have a couple of questions so we can complete your supplier profile in our AP system:

- Does Redwood prefer ACH (domestic) or do you accept wires (SWIFT) for initial and recurring payments? If wires are accepted, do you have an intermediary bank requirement?
- What are your standard payment terms (net 30 / net 45 / other)?
- Where should we send remittance notifications after payment? Is there a single remits inbox or do you use per-entity remits?
- Do you require a W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US)? Any other onboarding documents we should return?
- Preferred invoice submission method: email, portal upload, or vendor portal? If email, which address and what should be included in subject lines (PO number, vendor ID)?

We also have a short onboarding checklist we usually use — attaching so you can confirm any additional items on your side.

Attached: onboarding_checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

Appreciate any guidance and a pointer to the vendor form you want us to complete.

Best,
Karine Dupont
Head of Finance Operations
CopperRock Capital

Hi Karine — great to hear from you. Thanks for sending the checklist. Below are our standard preferences and the docs you can return to complete onboarding. Happy to hop on a quick call if anything below needs to be clarified.

1) Payment method
- Preferred (US): ACH for routine payments — lower fees and fastest clearing.
- Wires: accepted for one-off urgent payments or international settlement. If you do wire, please include full beneficiary details and any intermediary bank info.

2) Payment terms
- Standard: net 45 from invoice date for new suppliers. If a negotiated term exists on a signed SOW/PO we will honor that.

3) Remittance & invoice routing
- Invoices (PDF) should be sent to invoices@redwood.ai. Please include the PO number in the subject line when available.
- Remittance notices should be emailed to remits@redwood.ai (single inbox managed by Treasury). If you represent multiple legal entities at CopperRock, note that we can provide entity-specific remits once vendor activation is complete.

4) Tax & onboarding docs
- If you're a US entity: please return a completed W-9. Non-US entities: W-8BEN-E as applicable.
- Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and bank_proof_instructions.pdf — please complete and return alongside a voided check or bank letter for ACH, or SWIFT confirmation for wires.

5) PO process
- Procurement issues a PO after vendor activation. Until then, include the deal id (CR-3847) on invoices to tie to the procurement request.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, bank_proof_instructions.pdf

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - bank details & invoice routing questions

Hi Karine / Rishi — quick note from Treasury:

- Multi-currency: if CopperRock prefers EUR or GBP payouts we can handle FX, but we need the invoice currency indicated and whether you want payment in local currency or USD converted by Redwood.
- Wires: when sending SWIFT please include intermediary bank details if your bank requires them; otherwise include our beneficiary name exactly as "Redwood Inference Treasury" and the Swift code REDWUS33 (internal code - please also confirm with your bank). Do not include account numbers in email; use the secure upload in the vendor portal link Rishi provided.
- Legal entity info: please provide exact legal entity name, tax ID, and incorporation country so we can create the vendor record properly.

I'll also flag that for larger ongoing relationships we can create a virtual account mapping to simplify remits per client / business unit — happy to explore if helpful.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Treasury Operations | Redwood Inference

Karine — thanks for the template, that looks fine. Quick clarifications:

- PO timing: Procurement will issue the formal PO within ~48 hours of vendor activation. Until then, reference deal id CR-3847 and include "NO-PO" in the subject if a PO isn't available yet. Once the PO is issued you should receive an automated email with PO# — the subject will be formatted like: "PO# 2027-CR-3847 - Redwood Inference".
- Legal entities: please submit separate onboarding forms for CopperRock US and CopperRock UK (separate vendor records), include legal name and tax ID for each. We will confirm vendor IDs once Treasury completes validation.

I'll follow up with Procurement to prioritize issuing the initial PO after your form is validated.

Link to vendor portal + secure uploads: https://redwood.in/erp/vendor-portal/seed/CR-3847

Thanks again — if you complete the onboarding materials we should be able to activate vendors and generate PO(s) quickly.

Best,
